_about: THE web access rule, as cases: given an entitlements row and a moment, is the buyer entitled?
Three copies of the rule must agree: the website's hasAccess (kinderwell-web supabase/functions/_shared/entitlement.ts),
the app's isWebEntitled (mamalearn src/store/webEntitlement.ts) and redeem-handoff's hasWebAccess (mamalearn
supabase/functions/redeem-handoff/handler.ts). Each repo runs its copies over THIS file; the two repos keep it
byte-identical, and the app's scripts/check-migration-parity.sh fails if they differ (review 2026-10-07, AP-3/XR-3).
hours_after_end: how long after current_period_end the moment is (negative = before it; null = no end on file).

cases.why: the last hour of the period
renewal webhook late: billed, row not yet moved
the last hour of the grace
card retrying, inside the floored period
past_due gets no grace: the date is the answer
cancelled runs to the end of the paid period
a refund or chargeback never grants access
a status the rule doesn't know grants nothing
